newsitem.title: UK: Utd News extends Blenheim offers.
newsitem.headline: Utd News extends Blenheim offers.

text.p: British publishing group United News & Media Plc said on Monday that its offer to buy exhibitions group Blenheim Group Plc had become unconditional and would be extended until further notice.
In a statement the company said it would own, or had received acceptances in respect of, about 83.6 percent of Blenheim's enlarged issued ordinary share capital.

United News made an agreed bid for Blenheim valuing the group at 592.5 million stg, and is set to create the world's largest trade exhibition group with turnover of 500 million stg, based on last year's data.
